outline: This course is designed to engage students in intensive study and analysis of selected issues and problems in second language acquisition. The topics covered in this course include, but are not limited to, the following: language aptitude, cross-linguistic influences, personality, motivation, leaning styles, learning strategies, language anxiety, and learners' beliefs.
schedule:

2 First & second language acquisition I
3 First & second language acquisition II
4 Language Learning Context
5 Age
6 Theoretical perspectives I
7 Theoretical perspectives II
8 Mid-term
9 Review of mid-term
10 Learner language
11 Foreign language aptitude
12 Motivation I
13 Motivation II
14 Affect & individual differences
15 Dragon Boat Festival (no class)
16 Teaching approaches & instruction
17 Final exam
18 Review of final exam
scorePolicy: Active class participation & activities (25%); mid-term exam (35%); final exam (40%)
materials:
Hummel, Kirsten M. (2021). Introducing second language acquisition: Perspective and practices (2nd ed.). Malden, MA: Wiley Blackwell.
Ortega, Lourdes. (2009). Understanding second language acquisition. London, UK: Hodder.
